17.name: Operational Export & Interoperability

export-contract-models.evidence: Canonical export contract and normalized models implemented for Test Cases, Coverage Review, Regression Analysis, and export metadata.

canonical-parsers.evidence: Strict canonical parsers validated current testcase, coverage, and regression semantics without silently accepting legacy representations.

generic-export.evidence: Generic XLSX/CSV export implemented with human-readable headers, deterministic column order, multiline testcase steps, filtering, freeze panes, and usable column widths.

integrity-validation.evidence: Round-trip/integrity validation reconciles exported rows, identifiers, headers, semantic values, and regression tier membership against canonical Markdown sources.

generic-profile.evidence: Verified generic interoperability profile preserves canonical semantics while keeping normalized model keys separate from human-readable spreadsheet rendering.

operational-pilot-final-gate.evidence: My Rewards 3.0 pilot exported 63 Test Cases plus current Coverage Review and Regression Analysis; legacy artifacts were correctly rejected, current artifacts validated, spreadsheet usability findings were fixed, Human QC approved, and final repository validation passed.

17.scope: Provide deterministic operational export of canonical QA-AI artifacts to interoperable spreadsheet/tabular representations without making exports authoritative or weakening canonical semantics.
exit_criteria: Canonical export contracts and normalized models are defined for supported artifacts.
Strict parsers consume current canonical Markdown without silently normalizing unsupported legacy semantics.
Test Cases and Coverage Review can be exported to usable generic XLSX/CSV representations where lossless representation is supported.
Regression Analysis can be exported losslessly to XLSX with impact records and all three canonical scope tiers preserved.
Export validation reconciles identifiers, semantic values, headers, counts, and tier membership with canonical sources.
Human-readable spreadsheet headers and operational usability are verified by Human QC.
A real My Rewards 3.0 operational pilot passes export and validation while historical REV-001 evidence remains unchanged.
Final deterministic repository, metadata, output, adapter, and roadmap gates pass with a clean working tree.
17.freeze_evidence: Human QC confirmed PASS on 2026-08-18 after the My Rewards 3.0 operational export pilot. Test Cases exported 63/63 to XLSX and CSV; Coverage Review and Regression Analysis exported to XLSX under current canonical semantics; legacy Partial coverage and legacy regression scope representations were correctly rejected rather than silently accepted; spreadsheet header/usability findings were fixed; final validation reported canonical_scripts=36, broken_links=0, metadata issues=0, output issues=0, adapter PASS, roadmap synchronization PASS, and a clean main working tree.
